release_notes: v9.8.25 — (1) AlterID detection completely rewritten with a 3-tier fallback chain that includes a universal client-side iteration path: when Tally's TDL aggregation functions are unavailable (Tally Prime 7.0 commonly returns blank for $$Max:Collection), the agent now iterates the Voucher and Ledger collections directly via plain TDL REPEAT and computes max in Python — guaranteed to work on every Tally build from Tally.ERP 9 through Prime 7.0. (2) Fixed a regression where 1-and-2-digit AlterID values were silently filtered out by an overly aggressive length guard, causing fresh / freshly-installed Tally companies to be wrongly tagged 'unsupported'. (3) Added INFO-level logging so you can tell from a single sync run which detection path actually fired (Path-1 / Path-2 / Path-3).
